parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (1.017864) as it regressed slightly from my best (1.016710). The current DEPTH=6, LR=0.05, and WARMUP=0.05 configuration seems close to a local optimum. Next, I will test halving the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps per 5-minute training budget, potentially improving convergence for the DEPTH=6 model.
